reader.requirement: At --std 85 the page positioning a NEXT GROUP clause specifies takes effect only after the last line of its own report group is presented: the group itself prints where its LINE clauses put it, and only the following group sees the moved LINE-COUNTER.

edition-consulted.switches: WITH RESET on NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE is a 2002 construct, refused at 85
DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup (from 2002): at 85 a saved absolute next-group integer survives into TERMINATE's control footings

reader.edition-search: ApplyNextGroup and its three call sites have no edition test (grep of ReportWriter.cs for Edition|Dialect); the only NEXT GROUP edition arm is TerminateCore's DialectBehavior.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for when the positioning applies (after the group, at every edition); the TERMINATE save-location arm differs (see GR2).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf36_03 covers relative NEXT GROUP on CFs, an RH absolute and a PF absolute; absolute, saved and NEXT PAGE forms on body groups are not exercised

probes.printed: D1 (NEXT GROUP 10) printed on line 4, then LC 10; D2 (NEXT GROUP PLUS 5) on 11, then LC 16; D3 (NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE) on 17, then LC 20; PF (NEXT GROUP 22) on 21, then RF on 23
probes.expected: each group prints at its own LINE position; NEXT GROUP moves only LINE-COUNTER afterwards

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the WITH RESET phrase of NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE ... requires COBOL-2002 (accepted at 2023)
probes.expected: refused at 85: §1985:XIII.3.16.2 has no WITH RESET

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the '+' symbol for PLUS ... requires COBOL-2002

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR1  (3.16.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1 ("takes place after the presentation of the report group in which the clause appears")

reader.notes: ApplyNextGroup is called only after PresentLines returns, in each of the three presentation methods that can carry the clause. Probes confirm each group prints at its LINE position before LINE-COUNTER moves. g85_bf36_03 matches its golden.

refuter.evidence: ngcf (--std 85): CH-1 NEXT GROUP 8 printed on line 3 (its own LINE PLUS 1 from FIRST DETAIL), and the following DE printed on 9. CF-2 NEXT GROUP PLUS 3 printed on 11, and the next DE printed on 15. CH-1 NEXT GROUP 8 at line 18 printed there and then set LC to FOOTING with the save. PF NEXT GROUP PLUS 2 printed on 26, and RF followed on 29. Each group printed where its LINE clauses put it, and only the next group saw the moved LINE-COUNTER. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR1 ("takes place after the presentation of the report group").
